# ProCare Services LLC

> Medical billing, audit and compliance firm for primary care and specialty practices, working remotely inside the client's practice management system and payer portals.

## Services
### Revenue & A/R
- Aging A/R cleanup
- RCM (revenue cycle) management
- Medical coding
- Denial management
### Compliance & Risk
- RADV readiness
- HCC compliance (CMS-HCC V28, MEAT documentation)
- HIPAA
- Compliance program development
- BLS compliance
### Practice Support
- Practice startups (new practices and practice acquisitions)
- Credentialing
- Training and education
- Healthcare accounting
### Seamless Transition Program
- For practices switching from another billing or coding company: contract and notice-period review, parallel setup, claims cutoff plan, documented handoff, monitored go-live
### How we work
- Payer-side only: does not collect patient balances
- HIPAA: signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before accessing any data
- Oversight: AAPC CPC, CRC and CPMA credentialed audit support

## Who it's for
Primary care and specialty practices, practice managers and physician owners looking for help with aging insurance claims, denials, coding, RADV and HCC compliance, HIPAA, credentialing, or opening or buying a practice.
